"The ultrasonic water meters LXC15, LXC20, LXC25 are compact residential ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device, designed to measure, memorize and display the volume of clean water passing through the measurement transducers at metering conditions. Measurement is based on the ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle (difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses downstream and upstream). The meters can be installed in horizontal or vertical positions and are not designed to measure reverse flow. Essential parts: flow sensor (brass cylindrical body with two reflection sheets and two ultrasonic transducers) and calculator with indication device directly mounted on the flow sensor (PCBA board, electronic scrolling LCD display with 9 digits, indication range 99999.9999 m³, one non-replaceable lithium battery with 15 years lifetime). Optional non-essential parts: stainless steel ball valve, motor, and communication interfaces (optical port, pulse output, NB-IoT/GPRS/3G/4G/Cat1, MBus/RS485, LoRa/LoRaWan/Sigfox/WM-Bus)."
